'''Indranil Biswas''' (born 19 October 1964)<ref name="ias">{{cite web
| url=http://www.ias.ac.in/php/fell_all.php3?alpha=B
| title=Fellows
| publisher=[[Indian Academy of Sciences]]
| access-date=14 November 2012}}</ref> is an Indian [[mathematician]]. Currently, He is a [[senior professor]] of [[mathematics]] at the [[Shiv Nadar University]], [[Delhi-NCR]]. He is known for his work in the areas of [[algebraic geometry]], [[differential geometry]], and [[deformation quantization]].

In 2006, the [[Government of India]] awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology|Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]] in [[mathematical sciences]] for his contributions to "algebraic geometry, centering around [[moduli problem]]s of [[vector bundles]]."<ref name="ssb_citation">{{cite journal
 |url          = http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/pressroom/RnDNewsLetters/csirnews2k6/csirnews_15oct06.pdf
 |title        = Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prizes
 |journal      = [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research|CSIR News]]
 |date         = October 2006
 |volume       = 56
 |issue        = 19
 |pages        = 296–297
 |archive-url  = https://web.archive.org/web/20160305041708/http://www.csir.res.in/External/Heads/pressroom/RnDNewsLetters/csirnews2k6/csirnews_15oct06.pdf
 |archive-date = 5 March 2016
 }}</ref>

==Biography==
Biswas is an Indian citizen. He received a [[Ph.D.]] in [[mathematics]] from the [[University of Mumbai]].
